admission.claim: The fuzzer feeds raw bytes into a QBuffer device attached to a TGAHandler; TGAHandler::read parses the 18-byte TGA header and, for a supported RLE image type, invokes LoadTGA with the QDataStream positioned at the pixel data.
admission.observation: A TGA stream with an RLE image type (9, 10, or 11) and a valid header passes IsSupported and reaches LoadTGA with the stream positioned at the RLE-encoded pixel data.

root.claim: In the RLE decoding branch of LoadTGA, the stack buffer char pixel[8] is uninitialized and s.readRawData(pixel, pixel_size) reads pixel_size bytes without checking the return value; a truncated stream leaves part of pixel uninitialized.
root.observation: When the input stream ends mid-packet, readRawData returns fewer than pixel_size bytes, leaving the tail of the pixel buffer uninitialized while the code proceeds as if the full pixel was read.

propagation.claim: The uninitialized pixel bytes are memcpy'd into the malloc'd image buffer (dst) for each RLE run, and the conversion loop later reads those bytes to compute scanline colors.
propagation.observation: The uninitialized bytes are copied into the image buffer via memcpy and subsequently dereferenced in the color conversion loop (e.g., qRgb(src[2], src[1], src[0]) for 24-bit, or the Color555 bitfield read for 16-bit) to build each scanline.

target.claim: MSAN reports Use-of-uninitialized-value when the color conversion loop consumes the uninitialized pixel bytes copied from the RLE pixel buffer.
target.observation: authoritative runtime oracle: MSAN flags a use of uninitialized memory during LoadTGA's pixel-to-scanline conversion, matching the reported crash state LoadTGA -> TGAHandler::read -> kimgio_fuzzer.cc.
